definitions.explanation: Describing something of great size. A casual/emphatic alternative to 大きい.

examples.japanese: この{魚|さかな}でかすぎ！
examples.english: This fish is way too big!

examples.japanese: でかい{声|こえ}で{話|はな}すな。

notes:
でかい is a casual/emphatic version of {大|おお}きい. It may come from the Kanto dialect or from {凸|でこ} (protrusion).

REGISTER:
This is casual/colloquial language. Use {大|おお}きい in polite or formal contexts.

CONJUGATION:
As an i-adjective: でかくない (negative), でかかった (past), でかく (adverb form).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- でかい{態度|たいど}: arrogant attitude (lit. "big attitude")
- でかい{顔|かお}をする: to act big/arrogant
- でかすぎ: way too big
